text: The Russian Federation holds a controlling position in Bank VTB: Rosimushchestvo held 60.93% of ordinary shares (12.13% of charter capital) and Minfin 100% of first-type preference shares (32.88% of charter capital).

source.name: VTB - Shareholder structure (IR governance, archived)
